title: SS27 Girls' Couture Craft and Techniques
summary: Couture craft for girls: hand embroidery, smocking, handmade costume details and luxury "princess" dressing.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Speranza and Junona represent a luxury "princess" style<sup>[1]</sup>
- Selini Action makes handmade costumes decorated with shells, pebbles, seaweed and embroidery<sup>[2]</sup>
- Fatamadrina lists oversized florals, checks with fruit prints, paisley, vintage geometrics, nautical themes and gingham, and "Wildflowers Bloom" with delicate handcrafted embroidery<sup>[3]</sup>
- Halcyon Nights builds several graphic universes each season with patterns from a panel of artists; Bobo Choses publishes illustrated books alongside its collections<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Translating to ready-to-wear
sections.body:
- Smocking on yokes.
- Hand embroidery on one placement.
- Artist prints.

design_implications:
- Budget hand work for hero dresses.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
